outcomes.task: 各语言技能在不同课程的安排各有侧重：华文（基础）听说/口语互动 65%，阅读 25%，写作/书面互动 10%。
outcomes.gist_en: Basic CL weighting: written production + written interaction only 10% of emphasis; course is oral-led.

outcomes.task: 华文（基础）与华文（B）课程重在培养学生的口语交际能力，以听说带动读写。
outcomes.gist_en: Basic CL builds oral communication first; reading/writing driven by listening/speaking.

outcomes.task: 书面互动：能根据目的、情境和对象与人进行书面互动，交流情感、传达信息、表达看法。不同类型的写作包括便条、短信、书信、电子邮件、网络贴文等。
outcomes.gist_en: Written interaction goal (all courses incl. Basic, S1-4): interact in writing by purpose/context/audience; text types include notes, SMS, letters, email, online posts.

outcomes.task: 能在交换信息时，提出问题，并对他人的回答作出适当的回应。
outcomes.gist_en: When exchanging information, ask questions and respond appropriately to others' answers.

outcomes.task: 能对熟悉的话题表达感受或看法，并对他人的感受或看法作出适当的回应。
outcomes.gist_en: Express feelings/views on familiar topics and respond appropriately to others' feelings/views.

outcomes.task: 能根据目的、情境和对象选择书面互动的内容和用语；能尊重不同人的观点；能负责任地使用华文与人进行交流。
outcomes.gist_en: Choose content and register by purpose/context/audience; respect differing views; communicate responsibly in Chinese.

outcomes.task: 写作：能写简单的实用文，传达信息，并能表达感受或看法。
outcomes.gist_en: Writing (lowest band): write simple practical texts conveying information and feelings/views.

outcomes.task: 采用真实性评价……或者通过网络平台书面互动，使评价更具真实性。
outcomes.gist_en: Authentic assessment: suggests written interaction via online platforms.

method: CPDD: every writing task in the 2021 textbooks and teacher guides for this course (the site's writing task bank), sorted by the exam question it leads to. A task that matches no exam question is marked Builds toward.

method: CPDD: every writing task in the 2021 textbooks and teacher guides for this course (the site's writing task bank), sorted by the exam question it leads to. A task that matches no exam question is marked Builds toward.

Question numbers follow our 2026 TL papers, the same in every course and year: part அ Q1-Q2 (G2 and G3: reply to a friend's email, then a formal email; Higher TL: formal email, then a forum post), part ஆ Q3-Q5 (G2 and G3: incident essay, expository or opinion essay, story; Higher TL: incident essay, speech, opinion essay). SEAB K222, K322 and K357 say only email (Higher TL: formal email or forum) and essay or story.

BVSS 2026: tasks from our WA, EOY and Prelim papers and worksheets, each with a one-line summary; click a BVSS-set question for its full wording (cluster papers and SEAB questions show the summary only). WA questions will not be reused in 2027. Sec 4 in 2026 is the older course (4NA, 4E, Higher).

method: CPDD: every writing task in the 2021 textbooks and teacher guides for this course (the site's writing task bank), sorted by the exam question it leads to. A task that matches no exam question is marked Builds toward.

Question numbers follow our 2026 TL papers, the same in every course and year: part அ Q1-Q2 (G2 and G3: reply to a friend's email, then a formal email; Higher TL: formal email, then a forum post), part ஆ Q3-Q5 (G2 and G3: incident essay, expository or opinion essay, story; Higher TL: incident essay, speech, opinion essay). SEAB K222, K322 and K357 say only email (Higher TL: formal email or forum) and essay or story.

BVSS 2026: tasks from our WA, EOY and Prelim papers and worksheets, each with a one-line summary; click a BVSS-set question for its full wording (cluster papers and SEAB questions show the summary only). WA questions will not be reused in 2027. Sec 4 in 2026 is the older course (4NA, 4E, Higher).

method: CPDD: every writing task in the 2021 textbooks and teacher guides for this course (the site's writing task bank), sorted by the exam question it leads to. A task that matches no exam question is marked Builds toward.

Question numbers follow our 2026 ML papers and answer schemes: G2 and G3 Q1 reply to a post (Respons tidak rasmi), Q2 formal email; Higher ML Q1 formal email, Q2 forum. Q3 to Q5 are essays, narrative or expository, in varying order (SEAB K221, K321, K356). Speech texts set in Higher ML papers are not one of the SEC essay types and show as Builds toward.

BVSS 2026: tasks from our WA, EOY and Prelim papers and worksheets, each with a one-line summary; click a BVSS-set question for its full wording (cluster papers and SEAB questions show the summary only). WA questions will not be reused in 2027. Sec 4 in 2026 is the older course (4NA, 4E, Higher).

items.task: கனிவன்பு தினத்தை முன்னிட்டு உன் பள்ளி ஏற்பாடு செய்துள்ள பேச்சுப்போட்டியில் நீ கலந்துகொள்ளவிருக்கிறாய். 'தொண்டூழிய நடவடிக்கைகளை மக்களிடம் கொண்டுபோய்ச் சேர்ப்பதில் சமூக ஊடகங்கள் பெரும் பங்கு வகிக்கின்றன' என்னும் தலைப்பில் சிற்றுரை எழுதவும்.
items.gist_en: Speech: social media plays a big role in bringing volunteering to people.
items.gist_m: சிற்றுரை: தொண்டூழியத்தை மக்களிடம் கொண்டுசெல்வதில் சமூக ஊடகங்களின் பங்கு

items.gist_en: Comment: leisure activities can become a burden.
items.gist_m: கருத்துரைக் கட்டுரை: பொழுதுபோக்கு நடவடிக்கைகள் சுமையாக மாறலாம்

items.task: நேர்மையற்ற வழியில் வெற்றி பெறுவதைவிட நேர்மையான முறையில் தோல்வி அடைவதையே உயர்ந்த பண்புடையோர் விரும்புவர் என்பதை உனக்கு உணர்த்திய ஒரு சம்பவத்தையும் அதன்மூலம் நீ பெற்ற படிப்பினையையும் விவரித்து எழுதவும்.
items.gist_en: An incident that taught you people of character prefer honest failure to dishonest success.
items.gist_m: சம்பவக் கட்டுரை: நேர்மையற்ற வெற்றியைவிட நேர்மையான தோல்வியே மேல் என்று உணர்த்திய சம்பவம்

method: CPDD: every writing task in the 2021 textbooks and teacher guides for this course (the site's writing task bank), sorted by the exam question it leads to. A task that matches no exam question is marked Builds toward.

Question numbers follow our 2026 TL papers, the same in every course and year: part அ Q1-Q2 (G2 and G3: reply to a friend's email, then a formal email; Higher TL: formal email, then a forum post), part ஆ Q3-Q5 (G2 and G3: incident essay, expository or opinion essay, story; Higher TL: incident essay, speech, opinion essay). SEAB K222, K322 and K357 say only email (Higher TL: formal email or forum) and essay or story.

BVSS 2026: tasks from our WA, EOY and Prelim papers and worksheets, each with a one-line summary; click a BVSS-set question for its full wording (cluster papers and SEAB questions show the summary only). WA questions will not be reused in 2027. Sec 4 in 2026 is the older course (4NA, 4E, Higher).

P1.verdict: Yes, the same task in all three: one short written reply to an online post, 10% of the grade. The differences are in length, the platform named and how it is typed.
rows: Respond to an online post (回应网络贴文)
Online post responding to a blog or forum
Social-media post responding to a situation

Written interaction: the student replies to someone else's post, not a free-standing composition.
diff: Length is set in each language's own unit (characters for CL, words for ML and TL), so the numbers are not comparable across languages.
ML names a blog or forum; TL names social media and a situation; CL names an online post.

P2.verdict: Same shape (all multiple choice, 25%), different language items. CL and ML test language use and reading of practical texts; TL adds grammar, idioms and paired words.
rows: A practical text and two short passages
diff: The language-knowledge items are specific to each language (TL's idioms and paired words have no CL or ML counterpart).

Read aloud and stimulus conversation, 45% together
same: Same stimulus: a video before the conversation.
diff: TL scores reading aloud and conversation as one component.

rows: Email only: reply to an email, or write one from material
Forum/blog post (informal) or formal email (praise, reporting an incident, complaint)
same: Paper 1 is 30% in all three: functional writing 10%, composition 20%.
diff: Informal email: CL and TL only. ML's informal option is a forum or blog post.
Argumentative writing is named only in CL; ML lists narrative and expository; TL says essay or story.

P2.verdict: The biggest differences: each language tests its own grammar and vocabulary, and the reading sections are built differently.
rows: Dialogue completion and authentic texts; a narrative text, open responses
same: Paper 2 is 30% in all three, with an e-exam language section.
diff: Language items do not transfer across languages: CL cloze, ML word classes, TL idioms and paired words.

P3.verdict: The same in all three: read aloud 10%, conversation after a video 20%, listening 10%.
